tables.name: Noteworthy Official
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. One member of the capital's administration of particular note.

results.name: Adviser
results.description: Second in command of the city. Can be an official, or unofficial, position.

results.name: Ambassador
results.description: Regularly acts as a representative for the capital/nation when traveling abroad.

results.name: Catchpole
results.description: Catches and brings in debtors.

results.name: Champion
results.description: Ready to stand in for the leadership for any martial matters, either ceremonially or officially.

results.name: Clerk
results.description: Recordkeeper for the capital.

results.name: Exchequer
results.description: Responsible for taxes.

results.name: Guildmaster
results.description: Oversees one of the official (or underground) guilds, or factions, within the capital.

results.name: Herald
results.description: Responsible for disseminating official edicts, and other news, to the general populace. If serving in a courtly capacity, bears responsibility for knowing the names, titles of important individuals and announcing them when appropriate.

results.name: High Priest/Druid
results.description: The primary representative of the faithful to the capital leadership.

results.name: High Mage
results.description: The representative of the practitioners of arcane arts to the capital leadership.

results.name: Jailer
results.description: In charge of confining prisoners.

results.name: Judge
results.description: Decision-maker in legal matters.

results.name: Liner
results.description: Determines property boundaries.

results.name: Master of Intelligence
results.description: Responsible for seeking and utilizing information vital for capital/national security.

results.name: Master of Revels
results.description: Lead organizer of festivals and special events.

results.name: Master of Stores
results.description: Oversees the capital’s stores of supplies, such as grain or building materials.

results.name: Master of Trade
results.description: Responsible for the management of imports and exports.

results.name: Master of the Treasury
results.description: Responsible for the capital’s expenditures and paying contracts and debts.

results.name: Master of the Wild
results.description: Surveys the surrounding areas, mapping the wilderness, looking for monsters or other threats, and regulating hunting.

results.name: Roadwarden/Dockwarden
results.description: In charge of some, or all, of the capital’s transportation systems.
